Good evening everyone and welcome to the special council meeting on January 27, 2025.
Individuals interested in participating in this meeting were eligible to register online
using the delegation registration form at www.kitchener.ca slash delegation or via email
at delegation at kitchener.ca. Any written comments received prior to the commencement
of the meeting have been circulated to members of Council and will form part of the public record.
The meeting live stream and archived videos of this and all meetings are available at www.kitchener.ca
watch now. Before we begin today's meeting, we'd like to begin with our land acknowledgement. Today
we're gathering on the traditional territory of the neutral and Nishinaabeg and Haudenosaunee peoples.
We recognize our responsibility to serve as stewards for the land and honour the original caretakers who came before us.
Our community is enriched by the enduring knowledge and deep-rooted traditions of the diverse First Nations, Métis and Inuit in Kitchener today.
Before we begin the meeting, I'd also like to acknowledge that today marks International Holocaust Remembrance Day
and the 80th anniversary of the liberation of Auschwitz-Birkenau.
Today, our community joins individuals around the world in honouring the memory of millions
of Holocaust victims and survivors.
Collectively, we must push for an end to anti-Semitic behaviour in our community, in our country
and around the world, and call for a society free of all racism, hatred and violence.
I now invite all members of Council to stand and pause for a moment of silence in recognition
in memory of all those who were killed during the Auschwitz-Birkenau and all of the concentration
camps during that time period.
Thank you.
